run_mot_error_visualization: run the MOT error visualization script with a config file and result directory to generate error images
compare_res_gts: compare MOT inference results against ground truth for a given video and dataset
visualize_mot_errors: visualize false positive, false negative, and ID switch errors as colored bounding boxes on MOT frames
parse_mot_args: parse command-line arguments for MOT error visualization including config, result dir, output dir, and FPS
generate_mot_video: generate an MP4 video from per-frame MOT error visualization images with configurable FPS
